title.zh: Hyperliquid上英特尔股票合约24小时交易量跃升至板块第二，仅次于标普500
title.en: Hyperliquid上英特尔股票合约24小时交易量跃升至板块第二，仅次于标普500

current_state.zh: Hyperliquid's Intel stock perpetual contract surged to $308M in 24-hour volume — second in its equity sector behind the S&P 500 contract at $374M — with $119M open interest and $7.27M in liquidations, mostly longs, as Intel shares plunged nearly 29%.
